[[File:Shoggth_protoplastic.jpg|thumb|250px]]'''Shoggth Protoplasmic''' was a small shopping stall, selling collectibles from all over the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. It was located in a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shopping center close to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], and was run by a [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]].
